import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 300;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Edge {
        int dest;
        int rev;
        int flow;
        int cap;
        Edge(int d, int r, int f, int c) {
            this.dest = d;
            this.rev = r;
            this.flow = f;
            this.cap = c;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] adj = new List[MAX_N];
    static int[] level = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] ptr = new int[MAX_N];
    static int source, sink;

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c, int rc) {
        adj[u].add(new Edge(v, adj[v].size(), 0, c));
        adj[v].add(new Edge(u, adj[u].size() - 1, 0, rc));
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        add_edge(u, v, c, 0);
    }

    static boolean build_level_graph() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        while (!q.isEmpty() && level[sink] == -1) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                int v = e.dest;
                if (level[v] == -1 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int send_flow(int u, int flow_limit) {
        if (u == sink || flow_limit == 0) return flow_limit;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
            ptr[u] = i;
            Edge e = adj[u].get(i);
            int v = e.dest;
            if (level[v] != level[u] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = send_flow(v, Math.min(flow_limit, e.cap - e.flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.flow += pushed;
                adj[v].get(e.rev).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int compute_max_flow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (build_level_graph()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = send_flow(source, INF)) > 0) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static final int[] dr = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static final int[] dc = {0, -1, 1, 0};

    static int n, m;
    static int[][] blocked, time_limit, dist;
    static String[] initial, target;

    static void bfs_from(int r, int c, int[][] d, boolean use_time) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(d[i], -1);
        d[r][c] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{r, c});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            if (use_time && d[x][y] == time_limit[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dr[k], ny = y + dc[k];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n || d[nx][ny] != -1 || blocked[nx][ny] == 1) continue;
                if (use_time && time_limit[nx][ny] > -1 && d[x][y] + 1 > time_limit[nx][ny]) continue;
                d[nx][ny] = d[x][y] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        initial = new String[n];
        target = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) initial[i] = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) target[i] = br.readLine();
        
        blocked = new int[n][n];
        time_limit = new int[n][n];
        dist = new int[n][n];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                blocked[i][j] = (initial[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') ? 1 : 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (initial[i].charAt(j) == 'Z')
                    bfs_from(i, j, time_limit, false);
        
        source = 2 * n * n + 5;
        sink = source + 1;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (initial[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' || initial[x].charAt(y) == 'Y') continue;
                add_edge(source, n * x + y, initial[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                add_edge(n * n + n * x + y, sink, target[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                bfs_from(x, y, dist, true);
                for (int xp = 0; xp < n; xp++) {
                    for (int yp = 0; yp < n; yp++) {
                        if (dist[xp][yp] != -1 && dist[xp][yp] <= m) {
                            add_edge(n * x + y, n * n + n * xp + yp, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(compute_max_flow());
    }
}
